'''Sli'woon Biul''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|informant]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
At some point between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] hired Biul to follow [[Didina Lippinoss]] as she committed criminal actions in the service of [[Karrek Flim]], in order to gather incriminating evidence that [[Shalera]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] could use to blackmail Flim. Bombaasa hired a passing [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to convey Biul's data from a meeting place outside [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] to the [[Tyrena cantina]].<ref name="AED" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBothanInformationBroker.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Sli'woon Biul]]
Sli'woon Biul was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
